ko: [Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=1)]주마마는 드디어 부품을 살 돈이 생겼다고 몹시 기뻐하겠지.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]나는 충분히 강하니까, 돈이 있어도 쓸데없어.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]에스텔 언니도 하고 싶은 일이 있을 거잖아요.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]저는 가비알 씨와 함께 있고 싶지만……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]지금은 이쁜 옷을 사고, 자신이 즐거운 일을 하고 싶어요.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]하고 싶은 일을 그냥 하면 되잖아?
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]맞아요! 하고 싶은 일을 하면 되니까요.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]에스텔! 나를 봐! 그리고 움직이지 마!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]하고 싶은 일을 못 찾았으면, 가비알의 시련을 함께 하자!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]우와! 싸우고 있네요, 가비알 씨 엄청 멋져요!
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.01
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]If you had all of that money...
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]What would you do with it?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=1)]I bet Zumama would lose her mind. She could finally afford to pay for parts.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Me? I'm strong enough already. I don't need cash for anything.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]I wanna buy new clothes!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]I... I never thought about it before.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]There's gotta be something you want to do.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]At first, I just wanted to be with Gavial forever.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]And now I want to buy pretty clothes, and do things that make me happy~
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]But...
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0)]But I still want to be together with Gavial!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]I... I want...
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Just do what you wanna do. Simple as that, isn't it?
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Mm-hm! If there's anything you wanna do, then you can just go and do it~
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Estelle! Look me in the eye! Don't run!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]If you can't figure out what you wanna do, then join Gavial's Trial By Fire!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Trial 1, Tail Wrestling!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]Wha—
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]Um, um...! Fear me! Please!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Waaah! They're fighting! Gavial's so cool!
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.01
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]もしたくさんお金が手に入ったら……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]みなさんは、何に使いたいですか？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=1)]ズゥママならきっと、パーツを買う金が手に入ったっつって、興奮するだろうな。
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]アタシはもう充分強いから、別にそんな金必要ねぇけど。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]私は新しい服を買いたいです！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]わ……私は考えたことないかな……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]やりたいことはきっとあるはずですよ。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]最初の頃、私はずっとガヴィルさんと一緒にいたいとしか思っていませんでした。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]でも今は綺麗な洋服を買いたいですし、楽しいこともしてみたいんです。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]だけど……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0)]だけど、やっぱりガヴィルさんとも一緒にいたいです！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]わ……私は……
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]やりたいことがあるんならやりゃあいい、そうだろ？
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]そうですよ！　やりたいことがあるなら、やればいいんですよ！
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]エステル！　ちゃんとこっちを見ろよ！　逃げんじゃねぇぞ！
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]やりたいことが見つからねぇなら、アタシの試練に参加しろ！
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]試練その一、尻尾レスリングだ！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]えっと……
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]う、うん……！　よろしくお願いします……！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]うっわー、始まった！　ガヴィルさん最高です！
